description: Where WooCommerce stores keep product videos, by product meta key, independent of which plugin or theme wrote them. lib/product-video-extract.js reads these from a product's meta_data. Add a source with one entry; no code. `shape: object` reads one video from an object value (`url` names its field); `shape: url-list` reads an array of URLs.

sources.evidence: Seen on a live store: 7 products with a self-hosted .mp4/.mov; value {product_video_type, product_video_link, product_video_id, product_video_thumb}.
Plugin source admin/class-video-field.php: an array of URLs (YouTube, Vimeo or a file). The plugin saves [""] on products with no video.
